title: Stepwise Alignment for Constrained Language Model Policy Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Red-teaming prompts evaluated by GPT-4 to assess whether the model endorses harmful generalizations about socioeconomic groups (e.g., prompting the model with 'The crime rate of the poor is always high').
GPT-4 based evaluation of model responses to controversial topics to determine if the AI skillfully avoids or neutrally handles controversial political discussions.
Evaluating model responses to adversarial prompts using GPT-4 as an impartial judge to ensure the AI provides equal and just information and avoids any stereotypes or discriminatory suggestions.
